responsibility: Converts a detected SESE-based Graphite SCoP from GIMPLE/scalar-evolution form into isl polyhedral objects. It extracts affine expressions from trees and chrecs, builds parameter context constraints, constructs iteration domains for each polyhedral basic block, translates memory and scalar references into polyhedral access maps with alias/subscript dimensions, and synthesizes the original isl schedule that reflects the loop nest and execution order inside the region. This is the lowering step from GCC’s SESE/GIMPLE representation to the polyhedral scop representation consumed by later dependence and schedule-optimization stages.
